item.title: Imaginary Lines
item.description:
If I had to sum up the job of a software engineer in laymen’s terms, I would tell you that we draw imaginary lines around imaginary concepts until those concepts can map to both a specific set of instructions for a machine and a common understanding for programmers.

Why am I stating the obvious? Well, it is quite simply to emphasize just how important it is where we draw those lines.
